description: A small-business profit and loss statement (income statement) as exported from accounting software, possibly containing more than one report, such as a period comparison and a year-to-date report

company_name.description: The business the statements are for, as printed in the report header

accounting_basis.description: Accounting basis printed on the report, e.g. 'Accrual Basis' gives accrual

reports.description: Each separate profit and loss report in the document, in order

report_title.description: The report title as printed, e.g. 'PROFIT AND LOSS COMPARISON'

report_period.description: The period line under the title, as printed, e.g. 'August 2017' or 'January - August, 2017'

generated_at.description: The date and time the report was run, as printed in the footer

columns.description: One entry per amount column. A single-period report has one column; a comparison report has one per period, e.g. the current period and the prior period (PP)

column_label.description: The column heading as printed, e.g. 'AUG 2017', 'JUL 2017 (PP)' or 'TOTAL'

total_income.description: The Total Income line for this column

gross_profit.description: The Gross Profit line for this column

total_expenses.description: The Total Expenses line for this column

net_operating_income.description: The Net Operating Income line for this column. Negative when printed with a minus sign

net_income.description: The Net Income line for this column. Negative when printed with a minus sign

line_items.description: Every account line with an amount in this column, including subtotal lines, in printed order. Skip lines blank in this column

section.description: The section the line sits under

account.description: The account name as printed, e.g. 'Fountains and Garden Lighting' or 'Total Job Materials'

parent_account.description: The account this line is indented under, if any, e.g. 'Job Materials'
